# OpenHub

OpenHub is a hosted account + project service at https://openhub.run.
Each project stores a git working tree and an agent session log.
v1 is owner-only. There are no pull requests, issues, or anonymous push.

## Docs

- Guide: https://openhub.run/docs/guide.md
- Changelog: https://openhub.run/docs/changelog.md
- Human HTML: https://openhub.run/help

## Quick start

```
curl -fsSL https://openhub.run/install.sh | sh
oh login
# existing git repo (cwd): create links cwd, then sync
oh project create my-app
oh sync
# or link cwd to a project that already exists
oh init <project-id>
oh sync
# empty directory: clone instead
oh clone <project-id>
# optional: also push GitHub after OpenHub
oh github set owner/repo
oh sync
```

Auth is email + password (or a personal access token prefixed `oh_`).
Git Smart HTTP lives at `/git/{username}/{slug}` or `/git/{project_id}`.
Session events live at `/api/v1/projects/{id}/events`.
